description: Test tags added via Modifier.testTag(...). Static tags are exact ids; dynamic tags are templates keyed by an id / code / name. Tags are exposed as resource ids through testTagsAsResourceId on the root Surface in MainActivity and on AlertDialogError.
convention: <screen>_<action>_<type>; shared components use a fixed role-based prefix (alert_dialog_, content_error_, sorting_, bottom_navigation_, checkout_info_card_).
